LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Helon.]
Severe pains in right hip-joint, < during motion.
Numbness in feet, going off by motion, only felt when sitting still.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Helon.]
Stooping : < pain in head ; pain in occiput <.
Sitting down : tired aching in sacral and lumbar region.
Motion : burning sensation in top of head > ; numbness in feet > ; feels uterus move ; menstrual flow < ; pain in hip-joint < ; profound debility > ; of arms causes chills.
Wants to be continually moving about.
Least exertion : causes loss of fetus.
Going up stairs : palpitation.
Can walk but a few steps at a time.
Walking : excites pain during pregnancy.
   

NERVES. [36] [Helon.]
Tired, weary, drowsy.
General feeling of malaise.
Languor, unusually tired, yet knows no reason.
Great weariness, with copious acid urination.
Sense of profound debility is lost upon exercising.
Profound debility, as after severe acute diseases.
Debility after diphtheria.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Helon.]
Drowsy, heavy, sleepy during day.
   

TIME. [38] [Helon.]
Morning : yellow stools ; headache in occiput.
During day : sleepy ; colic-like pain in hypogastric region.
Afternoon : weariness, languor, weight in region of kidneys ; mind dull, inactive.
At 2.30 P. M. : dull heat and pressure in vertex.
Evening : weariness, languor ; mind inactive ; sensation as if cold wind was blowing up her limbs.
Night : must get up several times to urinate ; frequent erections ; burning and heat in dorsal region ; pain in back < ; in upper part of sacrum and pelvis <.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Helon.]
Air : chest sensitive to.
Warm room : < toothache.
Warm moist air : < sore throat.
From being in hot sun : eyes inflamed and burning.
   

FEVER. [40] [Helon.]
Chill, seemingly radiating from solar plexus all over body ; caused by motion of arms.
Flushes of heat pass over him on every movement while in a room.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Helon.]
Every morning, 5 A. M. : bitter taste.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Helon.]
Right : severe pains in hip-joint.
Left : pain in side ; sharp, spasmodic pain in back running to crest of ilium.
From within upwards : pressure into vertex.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Helon.]
As if band about an inch wide were drawn across from temple to temple ; spleen as if distended ; as if diarrhœa would come on ; as if skull was too full ; as if cold wind was blowing up limbs from heel to popliteal space ; as if front of chest had been compressed in a vice.
Pain : in head ; in occiput ; in left side ; in kidneys ; in back ; in ovaries ; in small of back ; in lower part of back ; about upper part of sacrum and pelvis.
Intense pain : in stomach.
Severe pains : in right hip-joint.
Piercing, tearing pain : in back.
Intense cutting, tearing pain : in urethra when urinating.
Sharp cutting and drawing pains ; during menstrual period.
Sharp spasmodic pain : in back, running to crest of left ilium.
Colic-like pain : in hypogastric region.
Cramp : of stomach.
Bearing down pains : in abdomen.
Burning, scalding : when urinating.
Painful soreness : over ovaries.
Pressing pain : in one or both temples ; in stomach.
Pulsative pain : in vertex.
Painful congestion : of stomach.
Constricting pain : in stomach.
Soreness : in womb ; in hypogastrium ; over ovaries.
Irritation : of vagina.
Burning : in top and front of head ; in kidneys, can trace their outlines by burning ; in dorsal region ; in stomach ; in spine ; in lower third of abdomen ; labia and pudendum.
Burning aching : in lumbar spine.
Aching : in spine ; in kidneys ; in region of bladder ; in chest ; in sacrum also down into each buttock.
Dull ache : in spleen.
Painful stiffness : of back.
Pressure : in hypogastrium.
Dragging weakness : in sacral region.
Lameness : of back.
Fulness : in forehead ; in vertex ; of stomach ; in hypogastrium.
Numbness : in feet.
Pressure : in forehead ; in vertex.
Heaviness : in hypogastrium.
Weight : in region of kidneys ; in womb.
Terrible itching : in labia and pudendum.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Helon.]
Chlorosis.
Anemia, atony, from prolonged hemorrhage.
Dropsy from albuminuria, general debility, uterine atony or after uterine hemorrhage.
Rheumatism.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Helon.]
Cannot bear least pressure of dress.
Extreme tenderness : of kidneys ; mamma and nipples.
Sensitiveness : of uterus.
Consciousness of a womb : feels it move when she moves.
   

SKIN. [46] [Helon.]
Paleness and icteric color of skin.
Jaundice.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Helon.]
Women : with prolapsus from atony, enervated by indolence and luxury, > when attention is engaged, hence when doctor comes ; worn out with hard work, do not care for sleep, so tired, and strained muscles burn and ache so.
Climaxis.
Girl, æt. 15 ; albuminuria.
Young woman, after getting feel wet ; threatened abortion.
Man, previously in good health, ill six weeks ; disease of kidneys.
Man, æt. 50, troubled occasionally for several years ; affection of kidneys.
Woman, æt. 65 ; diabetes mellitus.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Helon.]
It antidotes : Kali brom. (mental depression) ; Lil. tig. (prolapsus uteri).
Compare : Aletris, Ferrum, Phos. ac., Senec., Stannum.
